name: Lash Crack
description: Flick a supple lash of soul force across the target's will with a sharp crack of pain.

name: Lash Turn
description: Snap the lash back round the user to bat away a soul strike coming from the side.

name: Lash Reach
description: Let the lash trail out loose and read each soul it brushes for strength and mood.

name: Coiled Lash
description: Wind the lash tight about the will so the next crack is released with built up force.

name: Stinging Weave
description: Weave the lash in a quick lattice across the target so each stroke stings and the guard cannot settle.

name: Lash Wrap
description: Loop the lash round the target's will and pull it tight so their techniques come slow and clumsy.

name: Thought Sting
description: Sting the target's mind in the instant a thought forms so the idea comes out ragged.

name: Echo Ache
description: Strike once and leave a faint second ache behind it that arrives a moment after the first.

name: Dull Screen
description: Hold a dulling screen before the mind so that trailing pains arrive weak and short.

name: Pain Trace
description: Follow the thin trail of an ache back through a soul to learn where it was struck.

name: Mind Flinch
description: Press on an old ache in the target until the mind flinches away from the fight for a moment.

name: Trailing Hurt
description: Keep a slow pain running through the target's soul so their focus weakens a little with every breath.

name: Lingering Throb
description: Land a blow whose throb outlasts it and presses the target's will down as it fades.

name: Rending Slash
description: Rake an edge of soul force down the target's will and tear a ragged line through its calm.

name: Edge Catch
description: Catch a cutting soul edge on a hardened rim of will and turn it off its line.

name: Seam Reading
description: Run a light touch over a soul to find the seams where its force is joined most weakly.

name: Keen Breath
description: Breathe in slow measured draws while thinning the edge so the next tear bites deeper.

name: Seam Rend
description: Drive the edge into a found seam and pull it apart so the target's technique tears mid-form.

name: Splitting Draw
description: Draw the edge slowly through the target's will from crown to root and split its hold on the fight.

name: Spearpoint
description: Shape the force into a spear head and punch it through the outer layer of the target's guard.

name: Drilling Thrust
description: Spin the spear head as it pushes in so it bores deeper through a stubborn guard.

name: Pierce Screen
description: Thicken the will into a layered screen that stops a piercing thrust before it reaches the centre.

name: Probe Read
description: Study how the spear head slows or sticks inside a soul and read the guard from that.

name: Sharpened Will
description: Hone the will to a finer tip so each thrust meets less resistance on the way in.

name: False Probe
description: Jab at one part of the guard while the true thrust slides toward another so the target guards wrongly.

name: Deep Pierce
description: Send the spear head through every layer of the guard to the core of the target's will.

name: Skewering Rush
description: Rush the spear head through the target's focus and pin a technique in the act of forming.

name: Scatter Dart
description: Flick a small dart of soul force at the target and let it sting wherever it lands.

name: Dart Screen
description: Sweep a flat plane of will across the front to bat down a few darts thrown at the mind.

name: Fan Out
description: Spread the force wide like a fan and note each soul it touches before drawing it back.

name: Dart Loading
description: Load several darts of force into the will and hold them ready to be loosed together.

name: Stinging Rain
description: Let a quick rain of tiny darts fall on one foe until their guard flickers and thins.

name: Wide Volley
description: Loose a wide spread of darts that sting every soul in front of the user at once.

name: Darting Sequence
description: Send darts in a fixed order so the first opens the guard and the last lands on the opening.

name: Nerve Snap
description: Snap a sharp pulse of soul force against the target's nerve so their resolve jolts and slips.

name: Nerve Pinch
description: Pinch the target's courage with soul force until their next step falters and their guard drops.

name: Steady Nerve
description: Clamp the user's own nerve still so a frightening soul pressure finds nothing to grip.

name: Nerve Count
description: Test a foe's resolve with a light push and judge how near it stands to breaking.

name: Nerve Break
description: Crack the target's resolve outright so their will to press the attack gives way for a time.

name: Cowing Pressure
description: Lean on the target's soul with steady weight until they stop reaching for their techniques.

name: Thought Snuff
description: Pinch out a forming thought like a candle flame so the foe loses the plan they held.

name: Unravel Tug
description: Tug at one loose end of the target's focus until the whole thread of their intent begins to fray.

name: Clear Screen
description: Empty the user's mind and stand behind that clear screen so a probing soul finds nothing to take.

name: Thought Count
description: Gauge how many separate thoughts a foe is holding to learn how divided their attention is.

name: Empty Stance
description: Settle into a stance of no thought so the next stroke leaves the will without any hesitation.

name: Thought Unmaking
description: Dissolve the plan a foe is holding so the next several breaths pass with nothing in mind to act on.

name: Unspooling
description: Draw the thread of the target's attention loose so they lose track of where they stand and who they face.
